propositions: A ticket whose text exceeds 24,000 chars cannot complete bounded recovery, blocking legitimate merged work from reaching closed state

When completion verifier fails due to step budget exhaustion, the gate incorrectly reports missing agents extra instead of the verifier's own remedy, because recovery_failure_cause() returns None for CompletionRecoveryError
The criteria char bound (32,000) exceeds the context char bound (24,000) while criteria is a subset of context, creating incoherent validation logic
A compaction alternative that drops oldest comments silently deletes entire child tickets and their unmet criteria in epic verification, creating a signed-false-PASS vector
Raising context cap to 100,000 chars covers both blocked tickets (34,282 and 41,595 chars) without regressing the cost safeguard that ensures zero billable recovery calls on bound breach
Remedy selection must discriminate by failure cause rather than exception type, and size claims must be conditional on bound keys being present to avoid fabricated diagnostics
